items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: I did a season with the circus sitting beside my uncle. He played E-flat clarinet and I played B flat clarinet.

ctx.x: Well, I left -- the summer of '16 I went

with the circus and I did a season with the circus sitting beside my uncle. He played E-flat clarinet and I played B flat clarinet. Incidentally, we didn't bring in the time that I started studying clarinet. Four years of piano and then I had -- from 14 on I started studying clarinet.
